snippet.title: Switch: The Announcement
snippet.description: Switch is black-and-white puzzle platformer in which a detective searches for his lost cat. On this adventure, he comes across many strange obstacles, and will have to traverse in creative ways to reach new areas. For example, he might need to switch - rotating the entire world around - to find new pathways.
